description: Add outram-park-fork-dwsim-libs.workspace = true to crates/tampines/Cargo.toml once the pipe/valve/heat_exchanger/expander/pump ports land, so tampines::components (op-dt3.4) can build Pipe/Valve/HeatExchanger/SteamGenerator/Turbine/Pump on top of validated DWSIM-derived correlations rather than reinventing them. title: Wire outram-park-fork-dwsim-libs as a tampines dependency

description:
From the op-ffg6 audit, 2026-08-13. Mostly non-breaking. ~3-4 days. Depends on C1.

BLOCKED until the in-flight high-temperature-steel agent finishes in boussinesq_thermophysical_properties/ -- do not start before then.

THE 'ROUGHLY 40 SITES' FIGURE IN op-szmi.17 IS REFUTED. Measured for TUAS's boussinesq_thermophysical_properties/
specifically: 99 library-path panicking sites -- 58 .unwrap()/.expect(, 29 panic!, 12 todo! (excluding 62 in tests and
12 in doc examples). About 2.5x the remembered number. The 40 figure may have been about tampines-steam-tables, where
op-t647 quotes the same number.

Worst files: solid_database/nuclear_graphite.rs (24 incl. tests), solid_database/generic_heating_element.rs (18),
solid_database/ss_304_l.rs (17). There is now also ss_304_l_high_temp.rs (10 sites) from the in-flight steel work.

IMPORTANT FRAMING -- ss_304_l.rs calls range_check(..., 250.0, 1000.0) in seven places and ALREADY RETURNS Result
CORRECTLY. The 1000 K ceiling is honestly reported by the property layer. THE PANIC IS ENTIRELY INTRODUCED BY CALLERS
UNWRAPPING IT. This is why the audit recommends against copying op-t647's facade pattern here.

SPLIT OUT AS ITS OWN DECISION: solid_database/generic_heating_element.rs has 12 bare todo!() and is a stub that still
carries Pyrogel HPS data. The honest fix may be to DELETE or feature-gate it rather than convert it. Ask the maintainer.

notes.author: teddy0@arch-aftershock-rapid-glass-S267454
notes.content:
MAINTAINER DECISION, 2026-08-13: 'leave generic heating element out.'

solid_database/generic_heating_element.rs is OUT OF SCOPE for the unwrap/panic conversion work. Leave the file as it
is -- do NOT convert its 12 bare todo!() to Result, and do NOT delete or feature-gate it. It simply is not part of this
bead any more.

Practical consequence: the 99 panicking sites measured for boussinesq_thermophysical_properties/ include this file's
18. Subtract them when sizing the remaining work, and do not let a later sweep silently pick the file back up --
anyone counting todo!() across the crate will find these and should be told they are deliberately excluded.

(If the intent was instead to DELETE the file, that is a different action and has not been taken -- say so and it can
be done separately.)

title: C4 TUAS: property-layer callers -- 99 panicking sites, refutes the 'roughly 40' figure

description:
Amendment agreed in GitHub issue #35 (https://github.com/theodoreOnzGit/outram-park-backend/issues/35). SUPERSEDES an earlier pass in that issue's history which said the archive 'stays exactly where it is' -- that was the first-pass answer; this is the one being built.

The literature ARCHIVE CONTENT under crates/kovan-literature/ -- open/ (committable), proprietary/ (gitignored), generated/bibtex/, docs/, derived/ -- moves into its own dedicated repository (working name outram-park-lit, NOT YET CREATED, name not finalised) and is included back into outram-park-backend as a GIT SUBMODULE.

WHAT DOES NOT MOVE: the Rust crate kovan-literature (src/, its ingestion/BibTeX/catalogue machinery) stays exactly where it is in crates/kovan-literature/, as a normal workspace member. Only the DATA it operates on moves out.

WHY IT FITS: the extracted repo naturally ends up the same shape as a user's own Kovan root under the issue #35 redesign (s2-s7) -- OUTRAM PARK's literature becomes this project's own dogfood instance of the product.

EXPLICITLY NOT PART OF THIS: reformatting the extracted repo's internal layout into the new papers/topics/projects schema. Issue #35 s45 lists that as a non-goal -- it is a separate decision and separate work, not bundled here. This track moves the current open/proprietary/generated/derived layout; reshaping it, if wanted, comes later.

POLICY TRAVELS UNCHANGED: open-access literature in the new repo is still publicly readable like any public repo; the proprietary/-gitignored split and DATA_POLICY.md's access-tier rules move with it. Moving repos relaxes nothing.

SUBMODULE CONSEQUENCE: outram-park-backend pins a specific commit of the lit repo, and a plain clone does NOT pull the literature content unless 'git submodule update --init' is run. That is a FEATURE -- a bare clone of the code no longer has to pull however many archived PDFs.

*** PARTIALLY IRREVERSIBLE. NOT TO BE EXECUTED AS A SIDE EFFECT OF ANYTHING ELSE. *** This is a real repo-restructuring action: new GitHub repo, moving tracked history, submodule wiring, updating every doc/CLAUDE.md reference to crates/kovan-literature's current in-tree paths, and re-checking kovan-literature's Cargo.toml exclude list which currently assumes those paths are local. Tracked here as the agreed DESIGN; scope and confirm before moving anything.
title: outram-park-lit: extract kovan-literature's archive into its own repo, include back as a submodule

description:
primitives::uv_sphere produces clockwise-from-outside faces (negative signed volume ~ -4.07 for r=1), opposite to cube (+8) and cylinder (+6.12) which are outward-wound. Discovered while implementing the general boolean (op-hzs.12): the classify_point_uv_sphere test only checked winding_number().abs() so it never caught the sign. Fix uv_sphere winding to outward and add a signed-volume/orientation assertion across primitives.
